plan.goal: Explore the complete Shopify marketing, pricing, and onboarding funnel to evaluate user experience across form flows, state transitions, and mobile responsiveness.
plan.summary: The run will first execute the primary 'Start free trial' onboarding flow, transitioning from the homepage to the multi-step trial form. It will then test the login and account recovery flows on the admin page. Next, it will evaluate the pricing structures and 'Contact Sales' forms. Finally, it will verify informational resources and repeat key interactable checks in the mobile viewport to assess responsive design and tap target sizes.
assumptions: free-trial-form.html contains a client-side multi-step wizard to simulate onboarding.
pricing.html contains a functional monthly/yearly toggle for plan comparisons.
Forms like sales.html and admin.html have basic validation to test.
risk_hotspots: free-trial-form.html multi-step form navigation and state preservation
pricing.html plan comparison table and monthly/yearly toggle usability
sales.html form submission and missing input labels
Small tap targets (below 44px) on navigation links across all pages on mobile

phases.title: Trial Onboarding Flow
phases.objective: Validate the user journey from landing page to completing the onboarding questionnaire.
key_checks: Email input submission on index.html routing to trial flow
Navigation through the multi-step questionnaire in free-trial-form.html using 'Next'
Functionality of the 'Skip all' button during onboarding
Final success state or redirect upon finishing the questionnaire
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated through all steps of free-trial-form.html to the final state.

phases.title: Authentication & Admin
phases.objective: Test the login interface and recovery paths for existing merchants.
key_checks: Validation of email, password, and store URL inputs
Functionality of 'Log in' button and success/error states
Presence and responsiveness of 'Forgot password?' link
Clickability of social login options (Apple, Google, Facebook)
exit_criteria: Login form interacted with and error/success states observed.

phases.title: Pricing and Enterprise Sales
phases.objective: Evaluate the plan comparison features and lead generation forms.
key_checks: Toggling between 'Pay monthly' and 'Pay yearly' on pricing.html
Filling out the Contact Sales form on sales.html
Validating dropdown selects (company size, topic) on sales.html
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle changes state and Sales form can be submitted.

phases.title: Resources and Help Center
phases.objective: Ensure support and marketing content is accessible and well-structured.
key_checks: Navigation links in resources.html point to correct sections
Help center search input functionality in help-trial.html
Readability and layout of help center articles
exit_criteria: Resource links and help center search interacted with.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Verify that critical paths and dense layouts are usable on smaller screens.
key_checks: Tap target sizes for navigation and form buttons
Responsiveness of the pricing table and multi-step onboarding form
exit_criteria: Key pages checked in mobile viewport with layout warnings documented.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise form flows (onboarding, login, sales) and state toggles (pricing).
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat the primary free trial onboarding and pricing checks in mobile viewport to evaluate responsive layout.

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets, as they are prevalent across multiple pages and could be a major UX issue on mobile.
